hook: AI cyclone forecast gave *35%* odds to landfall near Yanam
hook_b: Would you trust an AI cyclone forecast over IMD?
tldr: NDTV Profit looks at where AI cyclone tracking works and fails; ECMWF's ensemble gave 35% to landfall between the Godavari delta and Yanam.

beats.what: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble assigned a 35% probability to landfall between the Godavari delta and Yanam, median time 07:11 IST (NDTV Profit).
beats.why: AI forecasts give probabilities, not one line on a map.
beats.care: For coastal Andhra, a 35% call means prepare, not ignore.
